findings.heading: Major revisions / Revisiones importantes
findings.proposition: The English lists the NEWS changes implemented in version 1.0.1 (R 4.2 update, {linelist} to {matchmaker}, guess_date() to parsedate::parse_date(), pivot_wider() id_cols= update, plot_age_pyramid() to age_pyramid(), ungroup() additions in heat plots and interactive plots, data.frame() wrappers in trending::fit()/predict(), case_when() to ifelse() in combinations analysis, epicontacts update); the Spanish has no NEWS block at all.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader cannot see which handbook code changed in version 1.0.1, so they cannot tell whether examples they learned earlier (for example {linelist} guess_date()) are superseded.

findings.heading: Major revisions / Revisiones importantes
findings.proposition: The English revisions table records a second release, '20 Nov 2022 | Release of version 1.0.1'; the Spanish table records only the 10 May 2021 release of version 1.0.0.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader believes the handbook's latest release is version 1.0.0 from May 2021 and does not know a later version exists.

findings.heading: Approach and style / Enfoque y estilo
findings.proposition: The English invites discussion about which R packages the handbook should emphasize; the Spanish instead says debate is welcome about which packages are the most used in the handbook.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader misses the invitation to propose changes to the handbook's package choices, and instead reads the sentence as being about a descriptive fact of current usage.

findings.heading: Editorial decisions / Decisiones editoriales
findings.proposition: The English rationale for choosing forcats is that its various functions also convert data to factor within the same command; the Spanish states that its various functions themselves become factors in the same command.
findings.reader_consequence: A Spanish reader gets a nonsensical rationale and misses the actual advantage of forcats, that one forcats call both reorders/recodes and coerces the column to factor.
